name: ZCA_ES_DATE_BUCKETS_B
description: This table is used to store a relative date bucket for an aggregation

columns.name: DATE_BUCKET_UUID
columns.description: The primary key.

columns.name: DATE_BUCKET_KEY_NAME
columns.description: Alternate Key for ZCA_ES_DATE_BUCKETS_B.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Whether or not the bucket is enabled for current use

columns.name: TIMEZONE
columns.description: The timezone to use relative to Today and a NULL timezone uses the user's timezone

columns.name: MIN_INCLUSIVE_FIRST_FLAG
columns.description: Y/N to indicate whether or not the min inclusive is computed first or not

columns.name: START_OFFSET
columns.description: The positive (or negative) number of units, specified by START_OFFSET_UNIT_TYPE_NAME, to shift Today by to get the min inclusive time stamp

columns.name: START_OFFSET_UNIT_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: The name of the date unit type for the start offset, i.e., Day, CalendarWeek, Month, Quarter, Year for computing the min inclusive time stamp

columns.name: END_OFFSET
columns.description: The positive number of units, specified by END_OFFSET_UNIT_TYPE_NAME, to add to the mininum inclusive start date time to get the max exclusive time stamp

columns.name: END_OFFSET_UNIT_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: The name of the date unit type for the end offset, i.e., Day, CalendarWeek, Month, Quarter, Year for computing the max exclusive time stamp

columns.name: MIN_INCLUSIVE_DATE
columns.description: The minimum inclusive number custom timestamp bucket

columns.name: MAX_EXCLUSIVE_DATE
columns.description: The exclusive number for a custom timestamp bucket

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Y iff the row was deleted, otherwise N

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
